full_track.tags: K-Pop Funk with a disco-influenced groove. The arrangement features a syncopated slap bass line, clean-toned electric guitar playing rhythmic 16th-note scratches and staccato chords, and a bright acoustic piano. The drum kit uses a crisp snare and a tight kick drum. Male vocals alternate between a smooth tenor chest voice and airy falsetto ad-libs. Brass stabs and subtle synth pads provide harmonic accents. The track is in B major at 118 BPM in 4/4 time.
